ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels; primary contrast boundary exists between the solid dark central region and the white-dominant lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a large, contiguous black geometric mass extending from the peduncle to the median notch. Distal lobes are primarily white with high-frequency black mottling, featuring distinct circular dark rings (rosettes) and vertical linear streaks concentrated on the inner-half of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 40-degree interior angle; notch apex is sharp and well-defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys; serration is most pronounced on the outer-third of both lobes, transitioning to smoother contours near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edges with an upward sweep toward the distal tips; leading edge displays a slight sigmoid curvature ending in narrow, tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple distinct circular/annular high-contrast marks; approximately 6 visible on the left lobe and 4 on the right lobe, appearing as dark outlines on white background pixels.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous vertical and diagonal black linear disruptions (rake marks) that intersect the white pigmentation of the lobes; densest clustering is observed on the medial sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple circular barnacle attachment scars and parallel linear rake marks across the ventral surface; distinct orange-brown pixel cluster visible at the extreme left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'butterfly' pigmentation pattern where the dark central mass extends irregularly into the white fields of the lobes; small isolated white pixel clusters present within the dark central region near the notch.
